info.author: district
info.name: core_loading
info.description: Gates Events.LOADING_READY per player until both core_bootstrap's server-side resource chain has finished AND that player's CEF frontend has reported ready - core_auth's AuthUiController.lua waits for this instead of opening the auth window too early. Also, client-side only, tracks THIS client's own resource download progress (onClientTransferBoxProgressChange/onClientTransferBoxVisibilityChange) and pushes it into the CEF browser for ResourceCheckScreen.tsx - entirely local, no server round trip.
